en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing the facade of a large Romanesque‑style cathedral with four tall towers and a central nave, seen from a square with steps, benches, trees, and a statue in front of the building. At the bottom front is the caption in Hungarian "Pécs, Székesegyház." The reverse side contains handwritten Hungarian notes dated 1935 Oct 6 and printed Hungarian text indicating rights reserved and the photographer/publisher in Pécs.
